description: This Kotlin file defines a singleton object 'Validation' that provides validation methods for email, password, and password confirmation inputs in the user interface.

methods.name: emailError
methods.description: Validates the email string; returns an error message if invalid or null if valid.

methods.name: passwordError
methods.description: Validates the password string; returns an error message if invalid or null if valid.

methods.name: confirmPasswordError
methods.description: Checks if the confirm password matches the password; returns an error message if invalid or null if valid.
